b16345339.desc:
Iris House Properties is pleased to present a high floor 3-bedroom residence with maid's room on the 35th floor of The Residences at Al Habtoor Grand. It faces Ain Dubai, Palm Jumeirah and the Arabian Gulf, and JBR beach is right at your doorstep. 

3,223 sqft
3 bedrooms + maid's room
5 bathrooms, including guest and maid's bathroom
35th floor, unit type B
[Fully furnished: confirm]
Covered parking
Handover Q1 2027

At 35 floors up, you're well above most of the neighbouring towers. The open living and dining area sits behind large windows, looking out over the Ain Dubai wheel, Bluewaters and the Palm, and in the evening the lights of the Marina. The kitchen is modern, there's plenty of storage, and the separate maid's room with its own bathroom gives everyone in the home their privacy. Indicative view footage from 35th floor height is available on request. 

The building suits families well. Children have their own play area and landscaped gardens, there are several pools, and security with CCTV and a concierge is on site around the clock. JBR beach is a short walk away, and supermarkets, cafés, pharmacies and clinics on The Walk and around Dubai Marina mean most daily errands don't need a car. 

Residents also have access to:

Fully equipped gym
Sauna, steam room and jacuzzi
Residents' lounge
Business center with high-speed internet
Prayer room

If you travel often or are looking for a second home in Dubai, the apartment works as a lock-and-leave residence, with concierge and security looking after it while you're away. Dubai International Airport is around 30 minutes away depending on traffic, and Media City, Internet City, the Palm, the Dubai Tram and the Metro are all close by. 

For investors, this is a high-floor unit in a branded resort tower in one of Dubai's most in-demand waterfront locations, and 3-bedroom apartments at this level with this view are limited in the building. As a resale before handover, you secure the unit now and pay the remaining balance on completion. The transfer is approved by the developer, and a property of this value may qualify for the UAE Golden Visa, subject to eligibility. 

Asking price: AED [16,950,000]
Paid to date: AED [. . . ]
Balance on handover: AED [. . . ]

The floor plan, view footage, developer show-unit photos and the full payment breakdown are available on request. Contact Noa Konopatzki at Iris House Properties to arrange a call or a meeting.

b15171879.desc:
Experience elevated waterfront living with this exceptional 2-bedroom apartment for sale at The Residences Al Habtoor Grand — an iconic off-plan development redefining luxury in the heart of Dubai Marina. Developed by Al Habtoor Real Estate, this prestigious high-rise tower offers an exclusive collection of sea-facing residences designed for modern sophistication, comfort and long-term value. 

This beautifully designed 2-bedroom residence features spacious interiors, floor-to-ceiling windows and elegant contemporary finishes, creating a bright and refined living environment. Residents can enjoy breathtaking marina and sea views, expansive living and dining areas, premium-quality fittings and a thoughtfully planned layout ideal for both end-users and investors. 

The Residences Al Habtoor Grand offers a resort-style lifestyle with an impressive selection of world-class amenities, including:

• Rooftop infinity swimming pool with panoramic sea views
• State-of-the-art fitness centre and high-tech gymnasium
• Private beach access
• Exclusive leisure and entertainment deck
• Luxury spa, sauna, steam room and jacuzzi facilities
• Outdoor tennis court
• Dedicated children’s play area
• Valet parking and secure resident parking
• High-speed elevators and 24-hour security services

Perfectly positioned in the vibrant Dubai Marina, the development enjoys seamless connectivity to Dubai’s key destinations, including Palm Jumeirah, Bluewaters Island and Sheikh Zayed Road. Residents will be moments away from upscale dining, retail outlets, luxury hotels, beach clubs and entertainment venues, making it one of Dubai’s most desirable waterfront communities. 

From an investment perspective, The Residences Al Habtoor Grand presents a rare opportunity to secure property in one of Dubai’s strongest performing real estate markets. With the continued demand for premium branded residences, limited beachfront inventory and Dubai Marina’s consistent rental returns and capital appreciation, this project offers strong potential for both high ROI and long-term growth. 

Whether you are seeking a luxurious waterfront home or a strategic real estate investment, this 2-bedroom apartment at The Residences Al Habtoor Grand delivers an unmatched combination of prestige, lifestyle and future value. 

For more information, please contact Bemnet Maru at Bait Maya Properties, one of the trusted property advisor is happy to assist you.
